name: Niagara Peninsula
terms: Vintners Quality Alliance, the appellation system for Canadian wine from British Columbia and Ontario. It guarantees the wine's origin.
Made from grapes frozen naturally on the vine and picked at ⟦temp|18°F|−8°C⟧ or colder. Canada makes more than any other country, over 90% of it in Ontario.
keyfacts: The Niagara Peninsula has the largest planted area of any viticultural area in Canada, covering ⟦area|13,600 acres|5,500 hectares⟧.
It is bordered by Lake Ontario to the north, the Niagara River to the east, and the Welland River and Hamilton to the south and west.
The Niagara Escarpment, rising to some ⟦elev|575 feet|175 m⟧ above sea level, passes through the appellation.
Lake Ontario moderates air temperature, and the main grapes are Chardonnay, Riesling, Pinot Noir and Cabernet Franc.

blurb.text: A Canadian appellation that holds a dozen named areas, including Niagara-on-the-Lake, Niagara Escarpment, Beamsville Bench, Twenty Mile Bench and Short Hills Bench.
